decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk system is close to an established furniture maker’s design and production knowledge, and the firm can likely improve the mechanism through supplier and engineering learning rather than exit quickly.
A chair family sits squarely within the firm’s core furniture capabilities, so absorptive capacity for refining design, ergonomics and variants is high.

Floor cushions made from carpets are more textile- and accessory-oriented than core furniture production, so the firm has less related knowledge to interpret early results and scale improvements confidently.

Although a soft upholstered sofa is adjacent to furniture, the weaker website presentation suggests lower commitment and the upholstery-specific know-how may not be strong enough to justify continued resources.
A high standing table is a straightforward extension of existing table and contract-furniture know-how, making it easier for the firm to learn from the launch and adjust the offer.
A rug collection is the furthest from the firm’s core manufacturing base, so without strong prior textile knowledge the firm is less able to absorb market feedback and improve it commercially.
